# I DO Entertainment

> Full-service event planning, premium rentals, and custom entertainment for weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across Toronto and the GTA.

## About

I DO Entertainment is Toronto's premier full-service event company, offering DJ services, photo booth rentals, catering, bar services, lighting & audio, and event rentals. We serve weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) including Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Etobicoke, Oakville, and North York.

## Services

- DJ Services: Professional DJs with customized playlists, MC services, and state-of-the-art sound equipment
- Photo Booths: Classic photo booths and 360 video experiences with instant prints and digital sharing
- Catering: Custom menus crafted by talented chefs with full dietary accommodations
- Event Rentals: Premium tents, furniture, decor, table settings, and game rentals
- Bar Services: Mobile bar with craft cocktails, professional bartenders, licensed and insured
- Lighting & Audio: Uplighting, dance floor lighting, PA systems, wireless microphones, and custom gobos
